overall_summary: Analysis of 46 deduplicated videos reveals a stark performance divergence. High-concept, visceral 'What If You Fell Into...' immersive exoplanet scenarios (e.g., Liquid Diamond Planet with 1,024 views, 38 likes; Burning Ice with 972 views; Darkest Planet with 825 views) generate 5x to 10x higher velocity (130-170 views/day) and 3-4% engagement rates compared to passive academic trivia. Repetitive psychology facts (fake memories, earworms) and static space trivia (silent space, cold stars) underperform severely (<100 views). Optimal Shorts duration for audience retention on this channel is 19-21 seconds.

winning_patterns.pattern: Second-Person Extreme Environment Immersion ('What If You Fell Into...')
winning_patterns.evidence: 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?' (1,024 views, 38 likes, 2 comments) and 'What If You Fell Into the Planet of Burning Ice?' (972 views) dramatically outperformed third-person declarative titles.
winning_patterns.action: Frame cosmic and planetary mysteries as high-stakes, direct experiential survival scenarios rather than textbook astronomy facts.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos under 16 seconds averaged under 120 views, whereas 21-second exoplanet Shorts averaged over 600 views and drove all channel comment engagement.
winning_patterns.action: Standardize script length to 20-21 seconds (approximately 50-55 spoken words) to allow build-up, sensory details, and an unexpected ending twist.

weak_patterns.evidence: Repeated uploads of 'Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories' flatlined at 5, 10, and 53 views; earworm titles generated only 17-71 views.
weak_patterns.action: Halt generic psychology uploads immediately unless paired with dramatic storytelling or micro-mystery formats.

weak_patterns.evidence: 'Why Space Is Completely Silent' posted three times yielded 33, 87, and 220 views; 'This Star Is Older Than the Universe' garnered only 11 views.
weak_patterns.action: Eliminate low-urgency 'Why X is Y' observational hooks in favor of active, high-consequence hooks.
